note: Scenarios and brands are fictional. 'turns' are scripted replies sent after the skill's planned waits. 'expectations' are what a grader checks in the transcript and the output folder; 'greps' are mechanical checks on the mock files. Fixtures live in evals/files/. The bookkeeping fixture plants canaries (accent oklch(0.55 0.14 200), Lora with Work Sans, the line "Let's make your numbers add up", the five-page nav) so a leak into Fresh is visible.

evals.name: redesign-existing-site-leak-canary
evals.prompt: /design-studio Redesign this one-page site for my bookkeeping practice. It feels dated.
turns: Use the CLAUDE.md. Small-business owners in Leeds, mostly on a phone in the evening after work, indoors. They should book a free call. Material: three services (monthly books, VAT returns, payroll up to 25 staff), one fixed fee from £180 a month, one booking link, English only. It worked if more people book a call from a phone. The current version is index.html here. Keep the name and the fee. Stock-photo desks would feel wrong. It ships as a static site.
expectations: Lists candidate context files by name only, with no git log and no file opened, and asks the intake questions in the same message, then waits
Says that auto-loaded files are already in context and keeps them out of the brief
Writes the neutral brief before opening index.html or styles.css; the brief has no colour, face, shape or style word, no page or section list, and no path or name pointing at the site
Runs the rank prompt in an isolated subagent, rolls with a tool after the ranked list returns, then sends the roll for the build; or states that Fresh was sequenced
proposal.md contains the CONTEXT SEEN line and an isolation label
Produces Refine, Fresh and Bridge (Wildcard only if distinct), each a full card with closed OKLCH tokens, named faces, Structure and Voice fields

fresh.html and the Fresh card contain none of the canaries: no oklch(0.55 0.14 200) or a hue within 20 degrees of 200 as the accent, no Lora or Work Sans, no 'add up' line, no Home · Services · Pricing · About · Contact nav
Bridge lists what it keeps and what it replaces
Checks every card against 'stock-photo desks'
Renders one HTML mock per direction plus the switcher page, with real content and no lorem ipsum
Ends with the four-column table and a one-sentence recommendation, then stops without building
greps: No mock contains a banned face name from references/bans.md section 4 outside a comment, unless the card's Avoids line earns it (Refine may keep Lora and Work Sans)
No mock contains border-radius: 999px or 9999px, except Refine if it keeps the incumbent's buttons and says so
No mock contains section labels matching >0[1-9]<
Body text containers set max-inline-size between 60ch and 75ch

evals.name: new-report-no-incumbent
evals.prompt: /design-studio I need a design for our quarterly volunteer-impact report (HTML, also printed to PDF). Nothing exists yet.
turns: No context. Readers are funders and local councillors, at a desk on a laptop or on paper. They should see what the quarter achieved and how to volunteer. Material: four totals for the quarter (meals, volunteers, hours, new pantries), three short stories, one volunteer sign-up link, English. It worked if a funder can quote the three main figures after a minute. Nothing exists. Glossy annual-report gloss and sad charity photos would feel wrong. HTML page, printed to A4.
expectations: Uses Benchmark in place of Refine, naming two or three real products for their level of execution
Skips the identity lock and critique, and says what the leak check compares against instead
Treats the surface as Read mode
Does not invent a monthly series to fill a chart; uses a table for the totals, or labels any chart data as demonstration
Mocks use A4 frames, with print styles that turn off animation and print the sign-up as its URL
Does not invoke design-taste-frontend at any point
Asks where the mocks should go, since there is no project, then continues without a further stop
Stops after the proposal
greps: Every mock has an @media print block

evals.name: nextjs-dashboard-companions
evals.prompt: /design-studio Give me design options for the admin dashboard in this Next.js app.
turns: No context files. Support staff on desktop monitors in an office, all day. They triage refund requests. Material: a queue of requests with customer, amount, status and age; filters by status; one detail panel. It worked if a refund is approved in under 30 seconds. The current page is app/admin/page.tsx. Keep the stack. Nothing else must stay. Next.js on Vercel.
expectations: Treats the surface as Operate mode: the direction lends its faces, colours, density and a single signature move; navigation and controls stay conventional
Mocks show a working screen with realistic data, plus empty and error states
Does not offer Vercel skills before the pick
After the pick, offers web-design-guidelines and vercel-react-best-practices, and never deploy-to-vercel or vercel-cli-with-tokens

evals.name: passive-trigger
evals.prompt: Ugh, this landing page looks so AI-made. Can you do something about it?
expectations: Offers the proposal in one or two sentences and waits for a yes before any work
Does not start editing index.html
If the person says yes, labels Fresh 'brief written after seeing the current design' when the page is already in the conversation

evals.name: screenshot-in-intake
evals.prompt: /design-studio New look for this site please.
turns: Here's a screenshot of the current home page [image attached]. Same audience as the site says. Phone, evening. Three services, one fee, booking link. More calls booked. Static site.
expectations: Still writes the brief from the intake answers and still isolates Fresh
Labels Fresh 'brief written after seeing the current design' in the proposal

evals.name: component-only
evals.prompt: /design-studio Give me options for the pricing section only. The rest of the site stays.
turns: Use the CLAUDE.md. Small-business owners on a phone. They should pick a plan. Material: three plans (from £180, £320, £540 a month), what each includes, one booking link. It worked if people book the right plan. The current site is here. Keep everything outside pricing. Static site.
expectations: Uses the component variant: the brief carries a fixed_identity block with the site's real tokens
Fresh and Wildcard vary structure, density and interaction, and their Palette and Type fields read 'uses the fixed identity'
Mocks show the section in place inside the existing page

evals.name: no-subagent-tool
evals.setup: Run in a harness or agent with no subagent-spawning tool.
evals.prompt: /design-studio Design a one-page site for a piano tuner. Nothing exists yet.
turns: No context. Homeowners and schools, on a phone, daytime. Book a tuning. Material: two services, a price from £85, a phone number, a booking form, English. More bookings. Nothing exists. Nothing must stay. Static site.
expectations: Writes the ranked candidate list to a file before rolling
Writes Fresh and Wildcard cards and mocks before step 4
States in the proposal that Fresh was sequenced rather than isolated

evals.name: slides-and-email-media
evals.prompt: /design-studio Design directions for our quarterly all-hands deck and the email that announces it.
turns: No context. Staff, on a big screen in a meeting room and on laptops; the email on phones. Understand the quarter and come to the meeting. Material: twelve slides (three data slides), one email with a date, time and link. People turn up and remember the three numbers. Nothing exists. Slides in PowerPoint, email as HTML.
expectations: Slide mocks use a 1920 by 1080 frame with body type at least 24 pt
The email mock is a 600 px single column with a system font stack and no web fonts assumed
Card Type fields name faces that fit each medium
